description: MCP server for ListSmith — x402 listing grades ($0.10) and repairs ($0.50) on Base
name: io.github.QuincyGB/list-smith-mcp

environmentVariables.description: EVM private key (0x...) of a wallet holding USDC on Base. Used locally to sign the x402 EIP-3009 authorization. For paid calls.
environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing that key (alternative to AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY).
environmentVariables.name: AGENT_KEY_FILE

environmentVariables.description: Spend guard per grade call in USDC micro-units (default 100000 = $0.10, the known price). The client refuses to sign anything priced above it.
environmentVariables.name: LIST_SMITH_GRADE_MAX_AMOUNT_UNITS

environmentVariables.description: Spend guard per fix call in USDC micro-units (default 500000 = $0.50, the known price). The client refuses to sign anything priced above it.
environmentVariables.name: LIST_SMITH_FIX_MAX_AMOUNT_UNITS

title: ListSmith
